purpose: Weekly operating review workflow from evidence to a finalized, copyable report.

package.commonContext: period-level project and calendar context only
package.venueReports: one independent report, data input, investigation, context, experience/action set and revision history per venue
package.legacyCombinedAnalysis: read-only compatibility reference for reports created before venue splitting

request.structuredFacts: immutable current, previous, and historical operating data
request.operatingFacts: events, execution, confirmed reasons, playback notes, and result evidence
request.retrieval: relevant historical conclusions and accepted experience

channels.meaning: Sales performance of all products grouped by sales channel.
channels.rule: channels and channelAnalysis must never be labeled or interpreted as card-only sales, even when a channel includes some card products.

cards.meaning: Facts for card products such as 5-use cards and 10-use cards, read only from the independent cards dataset.
cards.rule: cards and cardAnalysis must never be inferred, backfilled, or validated from channel salesTickets or salesAmount.

dataSemantics.crossScope: Channel and card facts are separate metric scopes. A relationship may be discussed only when explicit, traceable cross-scope evidence exists.

investigations.turns: ordered user answers and AI assessments retained in the card

analysis.reviewConclusions: report-writer records with one observation, one direct business judgment, one decision boundary, resolutionLevel, and writerStyleVersion
analysis.experienceCandidates: zero or more selectable/editable AI or manual candidates
analysis.evidenceTasks: zero or more evidence collection tasks attached to unresolved conclusions, never rendered as business actions
analysis.actionCandidates: zero or more selectable/editable intervention candidates; AI candidates require objective, rationale, scope, time window, owner, steps, metric, baseline, completion standard, stop condition, and linked conclusions
analysis.promptTrace: versioned prompt ids used in generation

rules: Causal dialogue stays inside its review card and is never copied into the final report.
Experience, evidence tasks, and actions are generated only after review synthesis.
Stopping a dialogue is independent from causal resolution; primary_supported is a resolved conclusion with explicit residual uncertainty.
Information collection is stored as evidenceTasks and must not occupy the next-action section.
Final report prose is written from the report author's perspective; investigation narration, operator quotation, and repeated metrics are forbidden.
The final report is available only after candidate curation and finalization.
channels and channelAnalysis are all-product channel sales facts (sales tickets and sales amount), never card-only facts.
cards and cardAnalysis contain only independent card-product facts and must not be derived from channels.
